name: Primal Reconstruction Algorithm
definition: A surface reconstruction method that recursively subdivides tetrahedra and constructs piecewise linear surfaces inside them, guaranteeing global embedding (no self-intersections) in R^3.
summary: The Primal Reconstruction Algorithm recursively subdivides tetrahedra to guarantee globally embedded, non-intersecting surfaces, distinguishing itself from standard marching tetrahedra by resolving ambiguous non-normal configurations.
